messages:
maria-partnerships: kicking off coordination for the joint marketplace + SI co-sell announcement. target window 2–3 weeks. need rules for lead handoffs, account mapping, and HW distro plan.
kevin-sales: SGTM. who owns the pipeline sweep? we should carve out top-tier accounts first.
arya-si-eng: we can commit an SE for integration demos. suggest intake tag `si:acme-demo` so it's searchable.
chris-product: recommend rule: SI can claim leads only after presales signoff + demo scheduled. prevents premature handoffs.
sophie-gobiz: I'll own the marketplace listing side. need SKU/metering details from the HW vendor and a short 1-liner for the catalog.
peter-hw-partner: sending HW pricing & sample stock by EOD. channel partner IDs: PKG-342,PKG-343. will attach CSV to the thread.
maria-partnerships: account mapping template (paste into /shared/si-handovers.csv and fill):
```
acct_id,acct_name,owner,region,engagement_stage,si_interest
```
kevin-sales: will run the sweep tonight and drop initial claims. Q: who resolves conflicting claims?
maria-partnerships: conflict policy proposal: priority -> (1) existing Redwood AE, (2) SI with verified engagement, (3) marketplace-origin lead. if conflict, escalate to @sophie-gobiz for final routing.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "SI co-sell intake sync" Thu 11:00am PT — attendees: maria-partnerships, kevin-sales, arya-si-eng, sophie-gobiz.
sophie-gobiz: can we add an SLA: SI must respond to a claim within 48h or ownership reverts to Redwood AE? :thinking_face:
arya-si-eng: 48h works for us. also propose adding a sandbox flag so demos are tracked: `demo-sandbox:true`.
maria-partnerships: thanks — action items: kevin = pipeline sweep, peter = provide SKUs + CSV, sophie = finalize listing copy and SLA, arya = demo readiness + sandbox. I'll open a GH issue to track and create the shared CSV. :thumbsup:
